messages:
maria_cs: Quick capture from this morning's Indigo Health onboarding call — they surfaced a few product asks and one potential renewal risk. TL;DR: pricing/visibility + 3 feature asks.

maria_cs: Their quotes — high-level: 1) per-route CSV export for cost reconciliation, 2) scheduled batched exports (hourly) for analytics pipeline, 3) embedding TTL control/refresh for frequently updated index.

maria_cs: Pain: finance team can't reconcile token costs by route (our docs + billing UI mismatch). They flagged this as blocking SSO rollout. Renewal risk: medium unless we ship a short-term mitigation before go-live in 3 weeks.

kevin_pm: thanks, @maria_cs. can you add the customer severity (P0/P1) and estimated affected traffic? also, do we have an existing ticket for per-route exports?

maria_cs: severity: P1 for export + billing clarity, P2 for embedding TTL. Affected traffic: 40k requests/day now, expected x2 after SSO. No existing ticket found for per-route CSV export.

aj_platform: adding a quick intake template so the product team can triage faster — use this for the ticket body:```
Summary: Indigo Health — per-route cost export + scheduled batch export + embedding TTL control
Impact: finance reconciliation blocked; SSO go-live risk (3 weeks)
Workarounds: manual CSVs from UI, inaccurate mapping
Requested timeline: 3 weeks (soft)
Acceptance criteria:
 - downloadable per-route cost CSV with date range
 - scheduled hourly export to S3 (csv/json)
 - embedding refresh TTL config (mins)
```

aj_platform: I'll create initial backlog items unless @kevin_pm wants to own.

sara_onboard: context from call: client wants export schema to include route name, model id, token counts (input/output), and cost breakdown per token type. They are using internal BI, so S3 delivery preferred. Also asked about tokenization edge cases in billing docs -> wants an example mapping.

kevin_pm: @aj_platform please create three tickets (billing-clarity, per-route-export, embedding-ttl). mark billing-clarity as P0 and loop in @nate_se for docs + eng validation. Put a note on cross-team impact (billing, runtime).

nate_se: got it. I'll validate billing calc with usage logs. quick question — do they want historical exports (backfill) or just new data from go-live?

maria_cs: asked for historical backfill for last 90 days. finance will validate numbers.

jira-bot: Created tickets: CS-3198 (billing-clarity), CS-3199 (per-route-export), CS-3200 (embedding-ttl) — links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-3198 (billing), CS-3199 (export), CS-3200 (ttl) :white_check_mark:

kevin_pm: nice. next steps: 1) @nate_se to prod-check billing math (EOD), 2) @aj_platform to draft scope and engineers needed (tomorrow), 3) @maria_cs to send handoff doc to Indigo with temporary reconciliation steps. I'll schedule a canary delivery for exports in staging next week.

maria_cs: noted. I'll ping Indigo with the mitigation steps and attach the sample CSV schema. thanks all! :pray:

sara_onboard: adding this to the onboarding checklist so future customers with finance stakeholders get early alignment. :memo:

kevin_pm: tagging for prioritization meeting on Thurs. If anyone spots a quick win we can ship before then, call it out here. :mag_right:

nate_se: found small doc mismatch — sending snippet in #docs channel.

maria_cs: ack. closing loop here for now.
